newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Santander calls Banco de Colombia a buy.
newsitem.headline: Santander calls Banco de Colombia a buy.

text.p: Santander Investment Securities Inc. said it was initiating coverage of Banco de Colombia with a "buy" recommendation even though it expects the bank's earnings per share to drop to $0.050 in 1997.

Santander said Banco de Colombia was expected to report earnings per share of $0.063 in 1996. After the drop in 1997, because of increased coverage of past-due loans and equity dilution stemming from its recent alliance with Spain's Banco Central Hispanoamericano SA, Santander said it sees earnings per share rebounding to $0.053 in 1998 and $0.063 in 1999.

"The US$120-million capital injection as part of the strategic alliance with Spain's Banco Central Hispanoamericano will help strengthen Banco de Colombia's balance sheet," Santander said in its report on Colombia's second-largest bank in terms of assets.
"We expect the bank to post healthy earnings growth from 1998," it said.
